from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any, Literal
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    payload: dict[str, Any]
    value: str | float | bool
    dup: int | float | None = None
    list_of: list[str | None] | None = None
    null_first: str | None = None
    all_null: Literal[] | None = None
    nested_any: str | int | bool | None = None
    plain: str | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            payload=data.get("payload"),
            value=data.get("value"),
            dup=data.get("dup"),
            list_of=data.get("listOf"),
            null_first=data.get("nullFirst"),
            all_null=data.get("allNull"),
            nested_any=data.get("nestedAny"),
            plain=data.get("plain"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "payload": self.payload,
            "value": self.value,
            "dup": self.dup,
            "listOf": self.list_of,
            "nullFirst": self.null_first,
            "allNull": self.all_null,
            "nestedAny": self.nested_any,
            "plain": self.plain,
        }
